language.description: Language used to scope Search Analytics. This is required for every Search Analytics operation, including filter-option discovery.

currency.description: Currency used to scope Search Analytics, or null when omitted.

channel.description: Channel used to scope Search Analytics, or null when omitted.

subChannel.description: Subchannel used to scope Search Analytics, or null when omitted or no channel is selected.

classifications.description: Nonblank classification key/value selections applied to the query.

description: Effective dimensions used to scope a Search Analytics operation.
